fixed_world.normal_goal: a XOR b XOR c XOR d XOR (a AND b)
fixed_world.twin_residual: XOR of all four triple conjunctions plus a*b*c*d
fixed_world.training: 11 cue anchors with Hamming weight<=2, lexicographically sorted, identical source-observed choice outcomes for NORMAL and TWIN
fixed_world.heldout: five relevant new cues Hamming weight>=3, lexicographically sorted, replay once each

protocol.train: try real action0; only on observed failure try real action1; 11 confirmed-success source memory; exactly 16 actually issued World Actions per arm
protocol.infer: After all 11 anchors, learn 11 GF2 degree2 coefficients; STRUCTURAL_S11 generic Gaussian elimination, CHEAP_DEG2 finite differences; FLAT_TAG no generalization, default action0
protocol.heldout: make learned/flat first choice, actually issue one Action and alternate only on observed failure, append both results to Memory, retain successful source as typed immutable S11 rule or cheap tag
protocol.replay: same five relevant heldout cues with new nuisance trial IDs, actual frozen S11 select_habit on all original trained/heldout rules; no new relevant combos during replay
